subject: Request: Senior approval for warranty & liability exceptions — AuraGrowth
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Alvarez <sarah@auragrowth.com>, contracts@auragrowth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Senior approval for warranty & liability exceptions — AuraGrowth

Hi Sarah / AuraGrowth contracts team,

Thanks for the detailed redlines. Quick summary on our side: 
- Customer is asking for a 25% one-year discount on list, a 30-day warranty window, and a liability cap of 3x fees (up to $3M).
- Standard Redwood position: 12-month warranty limit (limited remedies), liability cap = greater of $1,000,000 or fees in the prior 12 months (standard is $1M), indemnity narrow, and no open-ended warranty.

I've attached the redline (auragrowth_redline_v3.pdf) and the SOW (sow_auragrowth_v2.docx) for your reference. Given the size of this opportunity (see financials below) the deal team is requesting executive concurrence for non-standard terms and discount.

Why this needs exec approval:
- Liability cap increase from $1M to $3M is outside our deal desk tiers.
- Warranty shortening to 30 days is in customer favor for faster replacement/remedy windows (they want stricter uptime guarantees).
- Discount requested (25%) exceeds quota-level approvals and requires finance acknowledgement.

Deal snapshot:
- Account: AuraGrowth (healthcare analytics)
- Proposed TCV: $1.2M over 24 months (annualized $600k)
- Requested first-year discount: 25%

Risk mitigations we've secured so far:
- Customer carries cyber insurance (evidence requested; insurance summary attached in risk_memo_auragrowth.pdf).
- Indemnity carveouts limited to third-party IP and breach; we kept our usual data-processing limitations.
- SLA credits capped under the operational SLA section (still negotiating exact %).

Recommendation (deal desk / sales): Approve adjusted liability cap of 2x fees up to $2M and allow warranty limit at 30 days, conditional on a quarterly security review and signed attestation of insurance cover. Approve discount up to 20% (preferred) — 25% only with finance pre-approval.

Ask: We need a clear senior sign-off (Sales leader + CEO sign-off acceptable) by end-of-day Friday 3/18 to keep the signing momentum.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

On Thu, 15 Mar 2028 at 10:05 AM, Sarah Alvarez <sarah@auragrowth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mina — appreciate the note.
> 
> A few clarifications from our procurement team:
> - We can move on the warranty language if Redwood confirms faster turnaround for remediation (48h incident response required).
> - About the liability cap: 3x fees (capped at $3M) is our upper bound. We can accept 2.5x but prefer 3x due to the regulated data we process.
> - Please confirm whether an annual SOC2 + penetration test report is acceptable as evidence of security controls.
> 
> We can sign quickly once an exec is comfortable with the numbers. DocuSign ready on our side.
> 
> Best,
> Sarah Alvarez
> Head of Procurement, AuraGrowth
> sarah@auragrowth.com
>

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fw: Request: Senior approval for warranty & liability exceptions — AuraGrowth

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding for quick internal concurrence.

Summary / recommended approval path:
- Approve liability cap to 2x fees up to $2M (compromise between their ask and our standard).
- Approve warranty limited to 30 days with an explicit, narrow remedies clause (no extended warranties beyond code fixes).
- Approve up to 20% discount; anything beyond needs finance sign-off.

Financials & sales ask:
- Annual recurring value (expected): $600k
- Requested discount: 25% (we recommend 20% maximum)
- Reason to approve: strategic reference in NE region + expected expansion in H2 2028.

Risk memo highlights attached (risk_memo_auragrowth.pdf):
- Customer provided insurance summary indicating $5M cyber policy with breach coverage.
- SLA exposure is limited by credits (we propose a 6% cap on credits).
- Indemnity list narrowed; no product-wide warranty exposure beyond the 30-day fix window.

Please reply-all with: APPROVE / DENY and any required conditions so I can close this with Sarah and route to legal for final DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Alvarez <sarah@auragrowth.com>, contracts@auragrowth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Senior approval for warranty & liability exceptions — AuraGrowth

Team / AuraGrowth —

Thanks for pulling the details together. I reviewed Mina's recommendation and the risk memo. I will provide executive concurrence with the following conditions: 

1) Liability cap approved at 2x fees, capped at $2,000,000 (not $3M).
2) Warranty limited to 30 days; remedies remain limited to repair/replace/credit per the redline.
3) Discount approved up to 20% for year one; any incremental discount requires explicit finance sign-off and CRO acknowledgement.
4) Security: AuraGrowth must provide an annual SOC2 report plus evidence of most recent penetration test; Redwood Security will schedule quarterly check-ins in year one.
5) SLA credits capped at 6% of monthly bill (as noted in risk memo).

Subject to Legal preparing the DocuSign reflecting these items, go ahead and send the final for signature. Finance: please capture this under deal_id D-2028-045 and log the negotiated discount.

Aditya Rao
CEO | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
